group.name: Native Multimodal Foundation Modeling
group.definition: 텍스트·이미지·비디오·오디오·행동처럼 서로 다른 형식의 정보를 대상으로, 모달리티별 모델을 이어 붙일 때 생기는 표현 불일치와 이해·생성·행동 기능의 분리를 하나의 공통 모델 안에서 공동 예측하도록 해결하는 기술이다. 이를 위해 공유 토큰 또는 잠재 표현, 단일 Transformer나 통합 diffusion/auto-regressive objective, 멀티모달 사전학습을 사용하며, 일부 구현은 연속 행동·궤적이나 미래 세계 상태까지 같은 모델에서 출력한다. 다만 이 그룹은 범용 멀티모달 생성 모델, 실시간 스트리밍 모델, VLA 로봇 정책, 4D 장면 모델을 함께 포함하므로, 단일한 세부 메커니즘을 갖는 하나의 기술이라기보다 네이티브 통합이라는 공통 설계 방향을 묶은 그룹이다.
group.evidence_summary: 그룹의 여러 자료는 텍스트·시각·음성·비디오 또는 행동을 분리된 모듈의 조합이 아니라 하나의 foundation model에서 다루려 한다는 공통점을 보인다. 반복되는 문제는 모달리티별 표현 공간과 학습 목표가 달라 이해, 생성, 편집, 행동 예측이 서로 단절되는 점이다. 해결 방식은 공유된 이산 토큰이나 연속 잠재 표현을 구성하고, 단일 Transformer, autoregressive objective, diffusion objective 또는 이들의 통합 변형으로 모달리티 간 예측을 공동 학습하는 것이다. 일부 연구는 이 공통 백본을 연속 행동·궤적, 미래 기하 상태, 실시간 스트리밍 출력으로 확장한다.
group.why_emerging: 기존 멀티모달 시스템은 비전 인코더, 언어 모델, 생성기, 정책 모듈을 연결하는 방식이 많아 모달리티 간 표현 정렬과 기능 간 정보 전달이 별도 설계 과제가 되었다. 동시에 이미지·비디오·오디오·행동을 함께 처리해야 하는 응용이 늘면서, 단일 모델 안에서 이해와 생성을 함께 최적화하려는 요구가 커지고 있다. 이에 따라 이산 토큰화, 공유 잠재공간, 단일 스트림 attention, diffusion과 autoregressive 학습을 결합하려는 구조적 변화가 나타난다. 다만 현재 자료는 통합 모델의 구체적 구현이 크게 다르므로, 하나의 수렴된 아키텍처라기보다 공통 설계 방향이 형성되는 단계로 해석하는 것이 타당하다.

sources.title: ABot-N1: Toward a General Visual Language Navigation Foundation Model

claims.name: Embodied Visual-Language Navigation Foundation Models
claims.evidence: We present ABot-N1, a step toward a general Visual Language Navigation foundation model, that addresses these challenges by decoupling cognition from control via a slow-fast architecture guided by dual visual-language signals.

sources.title: Beyond Language Modeling: An Exploration of Multimodal Pretraining

claims.name: Unified Multimodal Foundation Models
claims.evidence: We demonstrate that the MoE architecture harmonizes this scaling asymmetry by providing the high model capacity required by language while accommodating the data-intensive nature of vision, paving the way for truly unified multimodal models.

sources.title: Beyond Pixels: From Video Priors to 4D Worlds

claims.name: Latent-to-4D Generative Modeling
claims.evidence: We ask whether the final denoised latents of video models that share a variational autoencoder (VAE) can instead provide a reusable interface to explicit 4D prediction. Building on this insight, we introduce direct latent-to-4D generation and instantiate it as Latent-to-4D, which bypasses RGB by aligning a video latent with the token grid of a pretrained 4D decoder and refining it through frame-wise and global spatiotemporal attention.

sources.title: Geometric Action Model for Robot Policy Learning

claims.name: 3D Geometry-Aware Vision-Language-Action Models
claims.evidence: We propose the Geometric Action Model (GAM), a language-conditioned manipulation policy that directly repurposes a pretrained geometric foundation model (GFM) as a shared substrate for perception, temporal prediction, and action decoding.

sources.title: Helios: Real Real-Time Long Video Generation Model

claims.name: Real-Time Long-Video Diffusion Models
claims.evidence: We introduce Helios, the first 14B video generation model that runs at 19.5 FPS on a single NVIDIA H100 GPU and supports minute-scale generation while matching the quality of a strong baseline.

sources.title: HY-Embodied-0.5: Embodied Foundation Models for Real-World Agents

claims.name: Embodied Foundation Models for Vision-Language-Action
claims.evidence: We introduce HY-Embodied-0.5, a family of foundation models specifically designed for real-world embodied agents. To bridge the gap between general Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and the demands of embodied agents, our models are developed to enhance the core capabilities required by embodied intelligence: spatial and temporal visual perception, alongside advanced embodied reasoning for prediction, interaction, and planning.

sources.title: ICLR 2026 Workshop on Multimodal Intelligence: Next Token Prediction and Beyond

claims.name: Next-X Predictive Modeling for Multimodal Foundation Models
claims.evidence: A growing body of work now frames this progress under the unifying paradigm of next-X prediction, where X may denote tokens, frames, or scales across discrete or continuous spaces.

sources.title: LLaDA2.0-Uni: Unifying Multimodal Understanding and Generation with Diffusion Large Language Model

claims.name: Unified Multimodal Diffusion Large Language Models
claims.evidence: We present LLaDA2.0-Uni, a unified discrete diffusion large language model (dLLM) that supports multimodal understanding and generation within a natively integrated framework.

sources.title: LongCat-Next: Lexicalizing Modalities as Discrete Tokens

claims.name: Unified Discrete Multimodal Autoregressive Modeling
claims.evidence: To transcend this limitation, we introduce Discrete Native Autoregressive (DiNA), a unified framework that represents multimodal information within a shared discrete space, enabling a consistent and principled autoregressive modeling across modalities.

sources.title: OmniLottie: Generating Vector Animations via Parameterized Lottie Tokens

claims.name: Multimodal Vector Animation Generation
claims.evidence: OmniLottie is a versatile framework that generates high quality vector animations from multi-modal instructions.

claims.name: Multimodal Diffusion Transformer for Unified Generation and Editing
claims.evidence: Qwen-Image-2.0 addresses these challenges by coupling Qwen3-VL as the condition encoder with a Multimodal Diffusion Transformer for joint condition-target modeling, supported by large-scale data curation and a customized multi-stage training pipeline.

sources.title: Qwen-VLA: Unifying Vision-Language-Action Modeling across Tasks, Environments, and Robot Embodiments

claims.name: Unified Vision-Language-Action Foundation Models
claims.evidence: We present Qwen-VLA, a unified embodied foundation model that extends Qwen's vision-language modeling stack from perception, understanding, and reasoning to continuous action and trajectory generation through a DiT-based action decoder.

sources.title: RoboPAD: Post-Training Adaptation of Robot Foundation Models
Seedance 2.0: Advancing Video Generation for World Complexity

claims.name: Unified Multimodal Generative Models
claims.evidence: Seedance 2.0 adopts a unified, highly efficient, and large-scale architecture for multi-modal audio-video joint generation.

sources.title: SenseNova-U1.5: Towards Native Unified Visual Intelligence

claims.name: Native Unified Multimodal Generation
claims.evidence: Together, these findings position native unified modelling as a promising path towards systems that perceive, reason and create within a fully end-to-end framework.

sources.title: SenseNova-U1: Unifying Multimodal Understanding and Generation with NEO-unify Architecture

claims.name: Unified Multimodal Foundation Models
claims.evidence: Hence, we introduce SenseNova-U1, a native unified multimodal paradigm built upon NEO-unify, in which understanding and generation evolve as synergistic views of a single underlying process.

sources.title: Speed by Simplicity: A Single-Stream Architecture for Fast Audio-Video Generative Foundation Model

claims.name: Multimodal Single-Stream Generative Modeling
claims.evidence: daVinci-MagiHuman jointly generates synchronized video and audio using a single-stream Transformer that processes text, video, and audio within a unified token sequence via self-attention only.

sources.title: VideoChat3: Fully Open Video MLLM for Efficient and Generalist Video Understanding

claims.name: Generalist Video Multimodal Large Language Models
claims.evidence: To address these issues, we introduce VideoChat3, a fully open, efficient, and generalist video-centric MLLM.

sources.title: Wan-Streamer v0.1: End-to-end Real-time Interactive Foundation Models

claims.name: End-to-End Multimodal Streaming Foundation Models
claims.evidence: Wan-Streamer seamlessly models language, audio, and video as both input and output within a single Transformer, where the sequence is represented as interleaved visual, audio, and text input tokens together with visual, audio, and text output tokens, coordinated by block-causal attention for incremental streaming.
